resolutions.title: Archived change-name resolution algorithm underspecified
resolutions.decision: specify active-first-then-archive lookup order with regex-match + latest-date tie-break
resolutions.action: Replaced the original 'Positional argument resolution (normative)' block in spec.md MODIFIED requirement intro with a fuller version specifying: (1) active match first at `openspec/changes/<name>/`; (2) if no active match, enumerate `openspec/changes/archive/` entries matching regex `^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}-<name>$`, lexicographically-latest date wins if multiple match; (3) if neither, treat as path/pattern scope. Mirrored in task 1.1 by adding explicit positional-resolution sub-step (a) before marker grep, with the same regex + tie-break rule.

resolutions.title: Resolution-log audit-trail fields promised by design but not enforced by spec/tasks
resolutions.decision: add new spec scenario codifying 5 normative audit-trail fields + optional tie_break_rationale
resolutions.action: Added new spec scenario `Auto-discovery resolution log captures audit-trail evidence` codifying 5 normative fields in the auto-discovered emission: (a) `source: "auto-discovered"`; (b) `source_path` (repo-relative path to selected JSON); (c) `source_command` (the selected JSON's `command` value); (d) `source_token` (filename `<TS>` token of selected JSON); (e) `latest_apply_token` (most-recent `apply-*.json` filename token, or `null`) — the apply-token field is what makes D-no-stale-detection auditable, fulfilling the design's audit-trail mitigation. Optional (f) `tie_break_rationale` when TS-token tie-break was invoked. Broadened task 2.4 to require updates at both the JSON-shape and field-note sites of run-summary-schema.md with full prose for each new field.

resolutions.title: internal-findings-format.md strictness section still says command must be `"review"` (residue from pre-iter-2 #4)
resolutions.decision: broaden the strictness bullet + sweep for similar v1-only-review framing
resolutions.action: Broadened task 2.1 to require fixing the L119 strictness bullet (currently says `command` must be exactly `"review"` for v1 — broaden to `"review"` OR `"audit-drift"`) AND sweeping the rest of the reference doc for any other v1-only-review residue. The residue is from #4's initial review-only scope before iter-2 expanded it; iter-2 fix landed in the parser sections but missed this strictness bullet.

resolutions.title: --from-file + change scope semantics ambiguous (exclusive or additive?)
resolutions.decision: Option A (exclusive) per user decision — --from-file overrides marker grep entirely, no additive behavior
resolutions.action: Added new 'from-file exclusivity (normative)' block to spec requirement intro making explicit that when --from-file is specified: marker grep does NOT run, auto-discovery does NOT run, the parser ingests the file as the ONLY input source; the positional (if present) is used only for emit-path resolution. Updated 'Explicit --from-file overrides auto-discovery' scenario to remove the additive-marker-grep parenthetical and explicitly state marker grep does NOT run. Aligns with the baseline pattern where default scan / scoped scan / --from-file are 3 alternative input paths, not combinable inputs.
